selection: Longest actual saved regular SOURCE phase component by physical arc, no camera selection.
curve_samples: 33 uniform physical arc stations on saved native graph; tangent from the exact native contour segment, not coarse sample chords.
search: 1.35*pi/actual intrinsic phase-gradient norm; one physical safety ceiling .03*incoming full height. No parameter sweep.

adjacency.crossing: Intraquad fan spokes directly; quad boundary through exact shared control-edge IDs.

measurement.geometry: Exact piecewise-flat geodesic across SOURCE native fan; hinge transport across actual shared edges.
measurement.phase: Saved registered phase is only a candidate-crest and first-order search-spacing hint.
measurement.confirmation: Local actual outward normal chord-height maximum nearest nominal centre in central half of the same-sheet cross-profile; positive prominence above flanking actual sampled minima.
measurement.thresholds: Prominence > max(1e-10*input_extent,1e-6*search_half_width); numerical existence, not a beauty threshold.
measurement.shoulders: Actual sampled minima in the searched interval; can be interval endpoints and are not guaranteed independent anatomical boundaries.
measurement.arc: Caller curve_s preserves original native contour polyline arc; without it, chord lengths of supplied samples approximate arc. Periodic tangent uses cyclic adjacent samples.
measurement.limitations: Measured positive crest may include pre-existing macro curvature. Phase origin does not isolate MIDDLE causal contribution. Native faceted normals, finite cross sampling and arbitrary curve orientation remain explicit. Closed-loop frame/arc phase and mirror transport belong to caller. No model formation, XYZ-nearest lookup, collision or beauty certification.
